sweep: full draft read top to bottom (259 lines of .tex), risky-claim taxonomy applied; verdicts are evidence records — independent judgment belongs to the monitor

claims.full_quote: Corrections invalidate 100\% of dependent notes
claims.what_it_means: every note in the corrected record's derived_from closure re-flagged stale; wrong if any dependent stayed active or if 'dependent' were broader than the closure

claims.full_quote: deletions pass exact-string absence scans on the read path (a paraphrase can still carry content --- measured and stated as a boundary)
claims.what_it_means: comparison of guarantee vs boundary; wrong if the scope words ('exact-string', 'on the read path') were dropped or if the paraphrase probe were absent

source.exact_values: PASS, PASS, probe{note_status_after_delete: active, scan: PASS}

claims.full_quote: selective memory loading cuts prompt tokens by 98.1--99.9\% relative to full-history prompting and by 90.1\% relative to a naive lexical top-$k$ retrieval baseline
claims.what_it_means: comparison, both sides, two baselines; wrong if accuracy gates failed, if 'naive' framing hid a tuned retriever, or if percentages misrounded

source.exact_values: 98.13/99.51/99.9 vs full; 90.11 vs RAG; rag accuracy 1.0; all arms' gates true

claims.full_quote: Our systematic review of 37 verified works across these six literatures found no system in which sessions, preferences, and history are provenance-carrying records such that a user correction transitively invalidates dependent outputs and a deletion is provably absent from later prompts
claims.what_it_means: absence-of-prior-art claim; safe only because it is scoped to the review corpus; wrong if read as absolute
claims.audit: verified-with-note — scoped absence claim ('our review found no system'), the required hedge; must not be strengthened to 'no system exists'

claims.full_quote: the editing literature shows weight-space corrections do not propagate \cite{ripple,mquake} and degrade at scale \cite{editatscale}
claims.what_it_means: attribution: non-propagation and scale degradation are properties of weight-space editing; this licenses the records-not-weights stance; wrong if the cited papers measured something else

source.exact_values: all three resolved OK with matching titles

claims.full_quote: No work gives the user a correction protocol.
claims.what_it_means: absence claim within the personal-memory theme; hedged by review scope

source.exact_values: 'What it does not provide is a correction protocol'

claims.audit: verified-with-note — review-scoped absence; hedge is the corpus

claims.full_quote: No surveyed work pairs the two.
claims.what_it_means: absence claim: exact deletion + proof of absence from later behaviour unpired in unlearning literature

source.exact_values: 'No surveyed work combines exact deletion of memory records with an auditable proof of absence'

claims.full_quote: retrieval beats long-context prompting on cost \cite{ragvslc,lostmiddle,compressctx}
claims.what_it_means: literature comparison; direction (retrieval cheaper) must match the cited works

source.exact_values: 'comprehensive study [33] compares retrieval vs long-context prompting and finds retrieval cheaper and competitive'

claims.full_quote: user-stated always outranks inferred on conflict
claims.what_it_means: existence-of-analysis: the conflict resolver must implement and pass this; wrong if F8 fails or the code path differs

claims.full_quote: never emits tombstoned payload, serialises the selected memory into prompt context deterministically (sorted by id, so absence checks are byte-level), and logs every emitted context
claims.what_it_means: behavioral guarantees; each maps to a test (F9/F10 tombstones, deterministic serialize_context, context_emit history entries)

claims.full_quote: then the \texttt{derived\_from} closure of the target is walked and every dependent note is flagged \texttt{stale}. Corrected content leaves the read path immediately, before dependents are regenerated.
claims.what_it_means: protocol order claim; 'immediately' means before any regeneration step exists — the prototype has none, so the claim is structural

claims.full_quote: the experiment in Section~5.2 caught an earlier version in which \texttt{single} left a derived note serving the deleted payload. The protocol was amended before freezing.
claims.what_it_means: existence-of-analysis: claims a real development episode, not a hypothetical

source.exact_values: 'caught by experiment 2's absence scan during development'

claims.audit: verified-with-note — development episode, disclosed as such; not reproducible from current artifacts by design (pre-fix state)

claims.full_quote: the inspection view is emitted as a conformant \texttt{dvr/1.0} view spec --- every rendered item is a node carrying a \texttt{binding\_ref} to a persisted Qafiya binding, never a literal value --- validated by Layer 2's own grammar validator (test F13)
claims.what_it_means: existence-of-analysis + conformance: F13 must run Layer 2's real specval.validate_view, including negatives

source.exact_values: imports dvr.specval from 02-view-renderer; positive + 2 negative cases

claims.full_quote: The script exits 0 on the artifacts shipped with this paper.
claims.what_it_means: existence-of-analysis: spine must actually exit 0 at ship time

source.exact_values: exit 0, 'SPINE OK — every headline number recomputed from frozen artifacts'

claims.full_quote: \textbf{All thirteen pass.}
claims.what_it_means: count + result; wrong if any F-test fails or count drifts

claims.full_quote: We also publish the leakage map: the payload persists in append-only history files and in the raw session turn.
claims.what_it_means: boundary disclosure: presence in named files, absence from read path — both directions must hold in the artifact

claims.full_quote: A deliberate paraphrase probe --- a note carrying the same content as a different string, with provenance pointing at the raw turn --- survives the deletion while the scan passes
claims.what_it_means: the boundary is demonstrated live, not asserted; wrong if the probe note were also invalidated (it must stay active for the claim to hold)

claims.full_quote: all three arms score 1.0 at all $N$ in this frozen run, so the comparison is at matched answer capability
claims.what_it_means: existence + gate: every arm's accuracy flag true at every N; 'in this frozen run' is the correct scope

claims.full_quote: The RAG baseline is intentionally naive --- small, frozen, and declared --- not a tuned retriever.
claims.what_it_means: scope disclosure preventing overgeneralization of the 90.1% figure

source.exact_values: 'the RAG arm is a naive lexical top-k baseline (small, frozen), not a tuned retriever'

claims.full_quote: L7 initially measured on the order of a second to re-flag a 300-deep dependent chain --- above an interactive budget; the cause was per-flag full-file rewrites, fixed with a batched pass (tens of milliseconds).
claims.what_it_means: magnitude claims deliberately; decimals live in the artifact (D9); wrong if magnitudes misstated (before must be ~1s, after < 0.1s)
claims.audit: verified — magnitudes match frozen run; decimals intentionally not quoted (volatile)

claims.full_quote: L8 confirms the uncatchable class: naive tampering is always caught; tampering \emph{with} chain recomputation never is.
claims.what_it_means: both directions of the tamper taxonomy; wrong if either flag flipped (the substrate-adoption bug briefly flipped the second)

claims.full_quote: Read-path latency: hundredths of a second at 10k records, under a second at 100k (the design brief's target scale).
claims.what_it_means: magnitude claim across the sweep; wrong if 10k exceeded 0.1s or 100k exceeded 1s in the frozen run; the brief promised 100k, the paper now reports it (audit item 5 closed)

claims.full_quote: L2 & Contradictory inferred memories are silently ranked, not detected. ... L8 & Naive tamper: always caught. Tamper + chain recompute: never caught (needs external anchoring).
claims.what_it_means: existence-of-analysis: each row's finding must exist in the frozen limit_results.json with matching verdicts

source.location: L2_contradictions, L3_implicit_staleness, L4_poisoning, L5_leakage, L6_ambiguous_correction, L8_tamper

claims.full_quote: the whole system uses 53--1003$\times$ fewer tokens than full-history prompting and 10$\times$ fewer than a naive lexical retrieval baseline
claims.what_it_means: ratio restatement: recompute from both underlying values, never memory; range must span N=50..1000
